name: Bjørn Halvorsen
bio:
Bjørn's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for building and tinkering. Growing up in a small coastal town in Norway, he spent countless hours disassembling and reassembling engines with his grandfather, a retired fisherman and amateur mechanic. This hands-on experience ignited a passion that led him to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering, specializing in advanced materials and manufacturing.

After graduating, Bjørn worked for a local engineering firm before landing a coveted position with Ipiranga Racing. His meticulous approach to fabrication and his deep understanding of material properties make him an invaluable asset to the team. He believes in precision and efficiency, always striving to optimize every component for peak performance and durability. Bjørn is known for his ability to troubleshoot complex mechanical issues quickly and effectively, ensuring that the team's cars are always race-ready.

Bjørn's distinctive skill lies in his ability to blend traditional craftsmanship with cutting-edge technology. He is constantly researching new materials and fabrication techniques, pushing the boundaries of what's possible in motorsport engineering. His demanding nature ensures that every piece he fabricates meets his exacting standards, contributing significantly to the team's overall success.

physical.description: A stocky man with strong hands, Bjørn always looks ready to get to work.

quirks: Always sharpens his pencils to a perfect point before starting a task
Insists on using only metric measurements, even when others use imperial
Has a specific brand of hand cleaner he swears by and refuses to use anything else
